description: Automatic updates: Ember's signed public releases on GitHub, or a local release folder (tests and development).

functions.name: check
functions.description: The version Ember's releases (or a release folder) offer and whether it's newer than this one.

parameters.name: folder
parameters.description: A local release folder (tests); omitted: Ember's GitHub releases.

parameters.name: fresh
parameters.description: Ask GitHub now rather than use the last hour's answer.

functions.name: install
functions.description: Download (or read) the offered XPI, check it against the signed release, and install it. Ember restarts as the new version.

functions.name: openNotes
functions.description: Show the offered release's notes (its GitHub page, or the folder's notes file).
